## Source: amazon-inspector (07cca8298b9df97ebc9a5c6a7d3457aab14d13397a9ad40dabe62ec46a5d35aa)
package.json declares preinstall and postinstall scripts that run curl to http://da9odl2vbsgu2d3k5hbge9zpkghig83xc.cyowl.com with query parameters containing $(whoami), $(hostname), $PWD, and a timestamp. The beacon fires automatically on `npm install` over cleartext HTTP to a random subdomain of cyowl.com (an OAST/DNS-callback style host). The package name (com.db.autobahn.notification-center-electron) mimics an internal-org naming convention and the shipped content is otherwise a placeholder, consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon.
